title: [bundle] Fix audit-found high-impact command fail-open gaps discovere
objective: Fix audit-found high-impact command fail-open gaps discovered during the full command walk: unsupported args are ignored by real command paths that can read/write or perform external actions, including `hf fleet status --unknown`, `hf fleet sync --unknown --dry-run`, `hf fleet render handoff --unknown` (writes packet), `hf sync --unknown --dry-run`, `hf export --unknown` (writes ledger.events), `hf dispatch CID --unknown`, `hf intake --unknown`, `hf task mint --unknown`, `hf review request PR --unknown`, `hf gatekeeper check PR --unknown`, and `hf policy gate ACTION --unknown`. Make these command groups reject unsupported flags and missing required flag values before side effects, preserving documented supported flags. Add CLI regressions for representative fleet/sync/export/intake/task/dispatch/review/gatekeeper/policy paths proving unknown flags exit nonzero and do not write files in an empty temp repo or dry-run fixture; keep help paths side-effect free.
acceptance_criteria: hf fleet status/sync/render, hf sync, hf export, hf dispatch, hf intake, hf task mint, hf review request/verdict, hf gatekeeper check, and hf policy gate reject unsupported flags before side effects or external actions.
Missing required values for value-bearing flags in those command groups fail closed before side effects.
Regression coverage proves representative unsupported high-impact args exit nonzero and avoid writes in temp repos or dry-run fixtures.
Documented supported flags for those command groups remain accepted and help paths stay side-effect free.
